summary: Learn account-based marketing for B2B growth with ICPs, account scoring, campaigns, and ABM dashboards. Book training for practical results.
lede: Account-based marketing for B2B growth focuses teams on selecting named accounts and coordinating personalized engagement around buying committees. For professionals working with B2B pipeline, CRM data, or campaign planning, this training develops practical skills to build an ideal customer profile, prioritize accounts, and map buying committees. Participants also plan account-specific campaigns, align sales and marketing workflows, and design dashboards to track engagement and pipeline influence.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with B2B pipeline, CRM data, or campaign planning and now need a more disciplined account-based approach. It is especially relevant if you sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and revenue reporting and need to improve account selection, coordination, and measurement.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop and be ready to work with spreadsheet templates, sample CRM exports, or account lists where available. No programming knowledge is required. Familiarity with B2B sales terminology, campaign metrics, and basic reporting will help you move faster through the exercises.
